caveats: Requires plugin 0.1.1+ and Paseo app/daemon 0.11.0-beta.4 or a compatible newer version.
Mark as unread uses the desktop/web workspace menu and targets its latest eligible chat, which may differ from the open chat.
The menu bridge requires a visible sidebar workspace; its final native desktop click has not been verified.
If automatic unread selection is unavailable, the workspace menu stays open with an informational notice.
